messages:
liam: hi team, opened my first PR to tidy up a couple helper funcs. quick checklist question: branch prefix, commit message style, squash policy?
sara: hey liam, welcome! branch name: refactor/<short-topic> or chore/<short-topic>. keep it <= 50 chars ideally.
aj: commit message: one-line present-tense (e.g., "Refactor: consolidate http helpers"). If you have multiple tiny commits, squash before merge unless the history is instructive.

Quick local prechecks:
```
pre-commit run --all-files
poetry run pytest tests/unit -q
```

If pre-commit changes files, add and re-run.

aj: reviewers: CODEOWNERS will auto-request reviewers for affected paths. double-check in PR sidebar. If touching runtime, cc @olivia.
olivia: ping me if any docker, k8s, or serving-code touched and i'll add infra/runtime reviewers.

liam: do refactors require changelog entries?
sara: only if behavior changes or bugfixes. pure refactors -> no changelog.

liam: PR title format?
aj: use optional ticket + short title, e.g., "ENG-789 Refactor: consolidate http helpers". PR body: what, why, how to test, and checklist (pre-commit, tests, CODEOWNERS).

liam: can I merge after approvals?
sara: need at least one approval + green CI. owners can merge; we don't self-merge unless you're an owner for that area.

merge-bot: CI: all checks passed \u2705 (build #5123)

liam: thanks! i'll squash the commits and add the checklist. appreciate the warm welcome.

sara: welcome aboard  happy to give a 10-min walkthrough of the repo layout if you want.
